---

```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

accommodation <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/tourism-accommodation-vila-seca-geocoding.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

clean_text <- tolower(paste(accommodation$public_name, collapse = " "))
clean_text <- iconv(clean_text, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
clean_text <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", " ", clean_text)
tokens <- unlist(strsplit(clean_text, "[[:space:]]+"))
stop_words <- c("by", "de", "del", "dels", "el", "els", "la", "les", "the", "sl")
tokens <- tokens[nchar(tokens) >= 3 & !(tokens %in% stop_words)]

frequency <- as.data.frame(table(tokens), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(frequency) <- c("term", "frequency")
frequency <- frequency[order(-frequency$frequency, frequency$term), ]

stopifnot(
  nrow(accommodation) == 17,
  nrow(frequency) >= 20,
  all(frequency$frequency > 0),
  frequency$frequency[frequency$term == "hotel"] == 5,
  frequency$frequency[frequency$term == "portaventura"] == 5
)

output_dir <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cloud_words <- frequency
frequency_range <- range(cloud_words$frequency)
if (diff(frequency_range) == 0) {
  cloud_words$size_mm <- 4
} else {
  cloud_words$size_mm <- 3.2 + 2.4 *
    (cloud_words$frequency - frequency_range[1]) / diff(frequency_range)
}

# Place larger words first on a deterministic spiral. Approximate text bounds
# prevent overlaps without adding a package-specific layout dependency.
placed <- data.frame(
  left = numeric(), right = numeric(), bottom = numeric(), top = numeric()
)
cloud_words$x <- NA_real_
cloud_words$y <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cloud_words))) {
  size <- cloud_words$size_mm[i]
  half_width <- nchar(cloud_words$term[i]) * size * 0.16
  half_height <- size * 0.34
  found <- FALSE
  for (candidate in 0:4000) {
    angle <- candidate * 0.55
    radius <- 0.46 * sqrt(candidate)
    x <- 50 + radius * cos(angle)
    y <- 35 + 0.72 * radius * sin(angle)
    bounds <- c(
      left = x - half_width,
      right = x + half_width,
      bottom = y - half_height,
      top = y + half_height
    )
    within_canvas <- bounds["left"] >= 2 && bounds["right"] <= 98 &&
      bounds["bottom"] >= 2 && bounds["top"] <= 68
    overlaps <- if (nrow(placed) == 0) {
      FALSE
    } else {
      any(
        bounds["left"] < placed$right + 0.8 &
          bounds["right"] > placed$left - 0.8 &
          bounds["bottom"] < placed$top + 0.8 &
          bounds["top"] > placed$bottom - 0.8
      )
    }
    if (within_canvas && !overlaps) {
      cloud_words$x[i] <- x
      cloud_words$y[i] <- y
      placed <- rbind(placed, as.data.frame(as.list(bounds)))
      found <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }
  if (!found) {
    stop("Could not place word without overlap: ", cloud_words$term[i])
  }
}

cloud_words$occurrence_group <- ifelse(
  cloud_words$frequency > 1,
  "Terme repetit",
  "Una aparició"
)
x_limits <- c(min(placed$left) - 2, max(placed$right) + 2)
y_limits <- c(min(placed$bottom) - 2, max(placed$top) + 2)

cloud <- ggplot(
  cloud_words,
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = term, size = size_mm, color = occurrence_group)
) +
  geom_text(aes(fontface = ifelse(frequency > 1, "bold", "plain")), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Terme repetit" = "#0B3A6E", "Una aparició" = "#647483")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits, expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "word-cloud-accommodation-names-vila-seca.svg"),
  cloud,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 4.0,
  device = svglite::svglite
)

repeated_terms <- frequency[frequency$frequency > 1, ]
repeated_terms$term <- factor(repeated_terms$term, levels = rev(repeated_terms$term))

stopifnot(nrow(repeated_terms) == 6)

bars <- ggplot(repeated_terms, aes(x = term, y = frequency)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, fill = "#4C78A8") +
  geom_text(aes(label = frequency), hjust = -0.35, size = 4, color = "#17202a") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(repeated_terms$frequency), 1),
    limits = c(0, max(repeated_terms$frequency) + 0.8),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Aparicions") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e0e6eb", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 18, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "word-frequency-bars-accommodation-names-vila-seca.svg"),
  bars,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 3.8,
  device = svglite::svglite
)
```
